items.title: Everyone is building AI agents. Who's designing the stop button?
items.excerpt: Michal Krzton argues that once AI can interpret, decide and act on its own, the hardest design decisions sit at the point where its autonomy ends, and shows how to make that boundary visible in product flows.

items.title: What I learned teaching AI prototyping at university
items.excerpt: A UPM fashion-school instructor swapped Figma for AI prototyping tools in a digital prototyping course and reports what non-technical students could build with generative AI, and the trade-offs.

items.title: Agents struggle with the same bad UX we do
items.excerpt: UX Collective essay on how computer-use AI agents stumble over the same confusing interfaces humans do, making interface clarity a design requirement for agent users too.

items.title: Sparseal releases AI-assisted retopology app CozyBlanket Pro for PC
items.excerpt: Sparseal launched CozyBlanket Pro, a standalone Windows/macOS toolkit whose AI continuously analyzes high- and low-poly meshes and suggests topology improvements to speed up retopology.

items.title: AI software clones are coming for big-name companies like Adobe
items.excerpt: A developer used Claude to reverse-engineer Photoshop, Lightroom and other Creative Cloud apps and released open-source vibe-coded clones, sparking debate over piracy, IP and subscription creative software.

items.title: Itch.io adds a filter for games with gen AI disclosures
items.excerpt: Itch.io added a 'No AI' filter to browsing and search based on creators' generative-AI disclosures; applying it cuts listed games from 1.77 million to under 425,000.

items.title: Autom8Labs launches AEC skills for AI agents
items.excerpt: Autom8Labs released MCP-based skills that guide AI agents through tasks in Revit, AutoCAD, 3ds Max, Grasshopper and other design tools.

items.title: nCircleTech launches nVibe AI app builder
items.excerpt: nCircleTech's nVibe lets AEC professionals describe a workflow in natural language and have the AI platform build the application, a vibe-coding tool aimed at architects and engineers.

items.title: Not all AI is helpful
items.excerpt: Nathan Partington of product design agency npd says start-ups now arrive with products already 'designed' by AI, creating unrealistic expectations and shifting what industrial designers are paid to do.

items.title: Nemetschek expands AI tools across building workflows
items.excerpt: Nemetschek's Max lineup puts Archicad Max, Allplan Max and Bluebeam Max on a shared AI and data platform. Note: Allplan Max 2027 was covered 11-02; only the group-wide Archicad/Bluebeam angle is new.

items.title: Is this the most controversial font since Comic Sans?
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq on the aggressive, slanted brush-script typeface that has become the giveaway of AI-generated posters in cafes and village halls, and why small businesses keep using it.

items.title: Taste Skill v2.1: How to stop AI websites looking the same
items.excerpt: Explainer on Taste Skill v2.1, an open GitHub skill that gives AI coding agents design taste so generated websites stop converging on the same look: how it works, how to install it, what it produces.

items.title: MOSS-Image 5B tested: Strong realism, shaky layout and text control
items.excerpt: Hands-on local tests of the open MOSS-Image 5B model's photorealism, bounding-box layout control and text rendering across a dozen scene prompts.

items.title: Seedance 2.5: The AI short film 'Planet Hell' explained
items.excerpt: How ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model powered the viral AI short film 'Planet Hell', and what it signals for AI video production.

items.title: Constraining agent CSS to design tokens (without pasting the whole theme)
items.excerpt: A developer shows how to keep coding agents inside a design-token system without dumping the whole tokens.css into the prompt, after agents kept inventing colors anyway.

items.title: From a Figma frame to an AEM EDS block in one command
items.excerpt: Open-source kit: paste a Figma frame link and get an Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery block (JS, CSS, Universal Editor model) via REST or the Figma MCP server, within Figma's rate limits.

items.title: Connecting Figma MCP to Zoo Code (macOS and Windows, using Codex CLI)
items.excerpt: Practical setup and troubleshooting guide for connecting Figma's hosted MCP server to a coding agent via Codex CLI on macOS and Windows.

items.title: Vercel MCP now renders deployments as an interactive card
items.excerpt: Vercel MCP now renders interactive deployment cards inside MCP Apps clients like ChatGPT, so status, build logs and debugging happen as generative UI in the chat.

items.title: How Zapier turns ideas into working software in hours with Vercel
items.excerpt: Customer story: Zapier turns weeks of partner-demo work into hours with v0 and builds internal apps in about a day.

items.title: Code-based prototyping: When it's worth the setup
items.excerpt: Eleken's head of design explains why the agency now prototypes with real components, including Claude-generated interactive dashboards, to test states and edge cases that static Figma mockups hide.

items.title: Build world models for interactive simulation with NVIDIA Cosmos
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's guide to adapting Cosmos world models to custom sensors, tasks and data and deploying them in interactive simulation applications for physical AI.
